May be an image of text that says 'TEACHING IS THE ONLY PROFESSION WHERE YOU TAKE WORK HOME, THINK ABOUT IT 24/7, AND STILL SHOW UP THE NEXT DAY READY TO GIVE YOUR BEST. SHOUT υT TO ALL THE TEACHERS MAKING A DIFFERENCE EVERY SINGLE DAY! S0A1US SCHO0LSUS'

Steve
TEACHERS, THIS ONE IS FOR YOU. Teaching has a way of following you home. It’s the lesson you’re still thinking about at dinner. The student you’re worried about long after the final bell. The papers waiting to be graded. The emails that still need answering. The activity you suddenly think of at 10 p.m. that might finally help something click tomorrow. And then morning comes, and somehow you walk back through those doors ready to do it all again. People often see the hours teachers spend standing in front of a classroom. They don’t always see the planning, worrying, preparing, grading, problem-solving, and emotional energy that happens everywhere else. So as another school year gets underway, here’s a reminder to every teacher doing far more than their job description could ever capture: The work you do matters, even when much of it happens where nobody can see it. Here’s to the teachers showing up and giving their best every single day.
Learn Laugh Teach
